test_cases.test_case: Successful login with standard_user
preconditions: User is on the Swag Labs login page
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the Product Inventory page; header with hamburger menu, title, and cart icon is visible

test_cases.test_case: Add single product to cart from Product Inventory
steps: 1. Click 'Add to cart' on a product in the product list
test_cases.expected_result: Button text changes to 'Remove' for that product; cart badge increments to 1

test_cases.test_case: Remove product from cart from Product Inventory
preconditions: At least one product added to cart
steps: 1. Click 'Remove' on a product that is already added to the cart
test_cases.expected_result: Button text changes to 'Add to cart' for that product; cart badge decrements accordingly

test_cases.test_case: Open Product Detail from inventory by clicking product name
steps: 1. Click on the product name of any listed product
test_cases.expected_result: Product Detail page opens showing product image, name, description, price, and Add to cart/Remove button

test_cases.test_case: Add product to cart from Product Detail
preconditions: On Product Detail page for a product
steps: 1. Click 'Add to cart' on the Product Detail page
test_cases.expected_result: Button changes to 'Remove' on Product Detail; cart badge increments; returning to inventory shows item as added

test_cases.test_case: Navigate to Shopping Cart and view added items
preconditions: At least one product added to cart
steps: 1. Click the shopping cart icon in the header
test_cases.expected_result: Shopping Cart page lists all added items with description, quantity (1), and 'Remove' buttons

test_cases.test_case: Continue shopping from Shopping Cart to Inventory
test_cases.expected_result: User is returned to the Product Inventory page; cart state remains unchanged

test_cases.test_case: Complete checkout flow for one item (Information → Overview → Confirmation)
preconditions: At least one product in cart
steps: 2. Enter valid First Name, Last Name, and Postal Code on Information step and click 'Continue'
3. On Overview, review order and click 'Finish'
test_cases.expected_result: Confirmation page displays 'Thank you for your order!'; clicking 'Back Home' returns user to Product Inventory and cart is cleared

test_cases.test_case: Cancel checkout returns to Shopping Cart from Information step
preconditions: At least one product in cart
test_cases.expected_result: User is returned to the Shopping Cart page; cart remains unchanged

test_cases.test_case: Cancel checkout returns to Shopping Cart from Overview step
preconditions: At least one product in cart
test_cases.expected_result: User is returned to the Shopping Cart page; cart remains unchanged

test_cases.test_case: Back to products from Product Detail
test_cases.expected_result: User is returned to Product Inventory page; cart state remains accurate

test_cases.test_case: Logout via hamburger menu returns to login page
test_cases.expected_result: User is returned to the Login page; protected pages require login again

test_cases.test_case: Reset App State clears cart without logging out
preconditions: At least one item in cart
test_cases.expected_result: Cart badge resets to zero and all 'Remove' buttons revert to 'Add to cart'; user remains logged in on Product Inventory page

test_cases.test_case: Sort products by Name A-Z
test_cases.expected_result: Product list is sorted alphabetically A to Z by product name

test_cases.test_case: Sort products by Name Z-A
test_cases.expected_result: Product list is sorted alphabetically Z to A by product name

test_cases.test_case: Sort products by Price low to high
test_cases.expected_result: Product list is sorted by price from lowest to highest

test_cases.test_case: Sort products by Price high to low
test_cases.expected_result: Product list is sorted by price from highest to lowest

test_cases.test_case: Open About link from hamburger menu
test_cases.expected_result: Browser navigates to the Sauce Labs website (external About page) in the same or new tab depending on implementation

test_cases.test_case: Cart badge updates when adding and removing multiple items
steps: 1. Add three different products to cart
2. Remove one of the added products
test_cases.expected_result: Cart badge accurately reflects number of items after each action (1 → 2 → 1 → 2); Add/Remove buttons reflect current state

test_cases.test_case: Finish order clears cart and resets badge
preconditions: At least one product in cart
steps: 1. Proceed through checkout and click 'Finish' on Overview
test_cases.expected_result: User returns to Product Inventory and cart badge is cleared; all products show 'Add to cart'

test_cases.test_case: Protected pages are inaccessible after logout
steps: 2. Attempt to navigate to Product Inventory URL directly
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to Login page and cannot access inventory without valid login

test_cases.test_case: Quantity displays as 1 for items in cart
preconditions: At least one product in cart
steps: 1. Observe quantity column for items listed in cart
test_cases.expected_result: Each item in Shopping Cart displays quantity as 1 (no quantity modification controls present)

test_cases.test_case: Clicking cart icon from Product Detail navigates to Shopping Cart
preconditions: On Product Detail page with at least one item in cart
steps: 1. Click the shopping cart icon in the header
test_cases.expected_result: User is navigated to Shopping Cart page listing current items

test_cases.test_case: Add and remove item from Shopping Cart page
steps: 1. On Shopping Cart page, click 'Remove' for an item
test_cases.expected_result: Item is removed from cart; its product entry shows 'Add to cart' on inventory; cart badge updates accordingly

test_cases.test_case: Order overview displays Item total, Tax, and Total
preconditions: At least one product in cart
steps: 1. Review the totals section on the Overview page
test_cases.expected_result: Overview shows Item total, Tax, and Total values; payment and shipping information are visible

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to log in with empty Username and Password
preconditions: User is on the Swag Labs login page
test_cases.expected_result: Error banner displays 'Epic sadface: Username is required.' (or relevant message); user remains on login page

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to log in with empty Username
preconditions: User is on the Swag Labs login page
test_cases.expected_result: Error banner displays 'Epic sadface: Username is required.'; user remains on login page

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to log in with empty Password
preconditions: User is on the Swag Labs login page
test_cases.expected_result: Error banner displays 'Epic sadface: Password is required.'; user remains on login page

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to log in with invalid credentials
preconditions: User is on the Swag Labs login page
test_cases.expected_result: Error banner displays 'Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service.'; user remains on login page

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to log in with locked_out_user
preconditions: User is on the Swag Labs login page
test_cases.expected_result: Error banner displays 'Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out.'; user remains on login page

test_cases.test_case: Attempt checkout with missing First Name
preconditions: At least one product in cart
steps: 2. Enter valid Last Name and Postal Code
test_cases.expected_result: Error banner displays 'Error: First Name is required'; user remains on Information step

test_cases.test_case: Attempt checkout with missing Last Name
preconditions: At least one product in cart
test_cases.expected_result: Error banner displays 'Error: Last Name is required'; user remains on Information step

test_cases.test_case: Attempt checkout with missing Postal Code
preconditions: At least one product in cart
steps: 1. Enter valid First Name and Last Name
test_cases.expected_result: Error banner displays 'Error: Postal Code is required'; user remains on Information step

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to access inventory without login via direct URL
preconditions: User is on the Swag Labs login page
steps: 1. Enter Product Inventory URL directly into browser address bar and navigate
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to Login page and cannot access Product Inventory

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to access shopping cart after logout via direct URL
steps: 2. Enter Shopping Cart URL directly and navigate
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to Login page and cannot access Shopping Cart

test_cases.test_case: Click Checkout with empty cart
test_cases.expected_result: System should prevent checkout (either disable Checkout or show message indicating no items to checkout) and remain on Shopping Cart page

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to use Reset App State to clear cart when app shows unexpected behavior
test_cases.expected_result: Cart is cleared and UI returns to consistent state; if reset fails, appropriate error or state persistence issue is detected (test expects reset to succeed)

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to add same product multiple times (quantity enforcement)
steps: 1. Click 'Add to cart' on a product
2. Click 'Add to cart' again for the same product (if present)
test_cases.expected_result: Product button toggles to 'Remove' after first click; subsequent clicks should act as Remove; quantity remains 1 in cart (no multiple quantity entries created)

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to proceed from Overview to Finish when item prices changed mid-flow (data integrity check)
steps: 1. Verify item prices and totals shown
test_cases.expected_result: Order completes using the displayed totals; any server-side price mismatch should be handled by the system (test flags inconsistency if detected)

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to click external About link when blocked/pop-up prevented
test_cases.expected_result: If browser blocks navigation, show appropriate behavior; application should not crash. (Test expects navigation to Sauce Labs site under normal conditions)

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to checkout while network is disconnected (error handling)
preconditions: At least one product in cart
test_cases.expected_result: Application shows an appropriate network/error message and does not proceed to Overview; state remains intact when network is restored

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to use locked_out_user to access protected pages via cookies/session
preconditions: Test environment has stored cookie/session for locked_out_user
steps: 1. Navigate to Product Inventory while presenting locked_out_user session cookie
test_cases.expected_result: Access is denied; user is redirected to login page with locked-out message if login attempted; session should not grant access

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to remove an item that is not in the cart (UI consistency)
preconditions: On Product Inventory or Shopping Cart page
steps: 1. Attempt to click 'Remove' for an item whose button currently shows 'Add to cart' (if direct DOM manipulation or timing issue)
2. Or simulate rapid remove request for item already removed
test_cases.expected_result: System should not throw errors; UI should remain consistent and reflect actual cart state; no negative item counts occur

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to submit extremely long input strings in checkout fields
preconditions: At least one product in cart
steps: 1. Enter a very long First Name (e.g., 10,000 characters), valid Last Name and Postal Code
test_cases.expected_result: System should handle input safely (either accept with truncation or show validation error); no crash or injection occurs

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to navigate Back browser button mid-checkout
test_cases.expected_result: User should be returned to the previous step (Information) or Shopping Cart depending on navigation history; checkout state remains consistent and no duplicate orders occur if Finish later

test_cases.test_case: Add all available products to cart and verify cart badge count
steps: 1. On Product Inventory page, click 'Add to cart' for every product listed
2. Observe the cart badge in the header after each addition
test_cases.expected_result: The cart badge count equals the total number of products available; all 'Add to cart' buttons change to 'Remove'

test_cases.test_case: Login with performance_glitch_user and observe load behavior
preconditions: User is on the Swag Labs login page
steps: 3. Click Login and measure time to reach Product Inventory
test_cases.expected_result: User is authenticated and eventually reaches Product Inventory; longer load time may occur but UI should remain functional once loaded

test_cases.test_case: Login with problem_user to detect broken images or UI problems
preconditions: User is on the Swag Labs login page
steps: 3. Click Login and inspect Product Inventory and Product Detail pages for anomalies
test_cases.expected_result: User logs in but certain UI elements (images or layout) may be intentionally broken; application remains navigable

test_cases.test_case: Verify Reset App State affects Add/Remove button states across pages
preconditions: Have some items added from Product Detail pages
steps: 1. Click hamburger menu and select 'Reset App State'
2. Visit Product Inventory and Product Detail pages for previously added items
test_cases.expected_result: All pages show items as not added (buttons show 'Add to cart'), and cart badge is zero

test_cases.test_case: Add and remove items rapidly to expose race conditions
steps: 1. Rapidly click 'Add to cart' and 'Remove' on multiple products in quick succession
test_cases.expected_result: Cart badge remains accurate and no duplicate or negative counts occur; UI buttons reflect final state

test_cases.test_case: Verify checkout with international postal code formats
preconditions: At least one product in cart
steps: 1. Enter valid First and Last Name
test_cases.expected_result: System accepts typical postal code formats or provides clear validation for required format; checkout proceeds or shows postal code-specific error message

test_cases.test_case: Verify behavior when Product Inventory list is empty (no products)
preconditions: Test environment configured with zero products (if possible)
test_cases.expected_result: Inventory page shows an appropriate empty state (message or no product cards); cart actions are not possible; UI remains stable

test_cases.test_case: Verify long product names/descriptions render without breaking layout
preconditions: Products exist with long names/descriptions (test data)
steps: 1. View Product Inventory and Product Detail pages for long-text products
test_cases.expected_result: Long product names/descriptions wrap or truncate gracefully without breaking layout or hiding Add to cart buttons

test_cases.test_case: Verify cart persistence across page refresh
preconditions: At least one product in cart
steps: 1. Refresh the browser on Product Inventory or Shopping Cart page
test_cases.expected_result: Cart badge and cart contents persist after page refresh (unless Reset App State used); UI remains consistent

test_cases.test_case: Verify Checkout Overview handles multiple items with correct itemization and totals
steps: 1. Review that each cart item is listed with correct price
2. Verify sum matches Item total and overall Total including Tax
test_cases.expected_result: Overview displays accurate itemization and calculated totals; rounding and display precision are correct

test_cases.test_case: Verify behavior when browser back/forward is used through app flows
steps: 1. Navigate through Inventory → Detail → Cart → Checkout
2. Use browser Back and Forward buttons at various points
test_cases.expected_result: Application navigation remains consistent; state (cart contents and checkout steps) remains usable without creating duplicate or stale states

test_cases.test_case: Verify UI header persists and is functional on all pages
preconditions: User logged in as any valid user
steps: 1. Navigate to Inventory, Product Detail, Shopping Cart, Checkout steps, and Confirmation page
2. Observe header presence and try using hamburger menu and cart icon on each page
test_cases.expected_result: Header with hamburger menu, title, and cart icon persists and functions consistently across pages

test_cases.test_case: Verify 'Back Home' on Confirmation returns and clears cart even after page refresh
preconditions: Complete checkout and reach Confirmation page
test_cases.expected_result: User is returned to Product Inventory and cart remains cleared; no residual items reappear after refresh

test_cases.test_case: Verify sorting stability when multiple products share the same name or price
preconditions: Inventory contains products with identical names or prices
steps: 1. Sort by Name A-Z and observe order of equal-name items
2. Sort by Price low-high and observe order of equal-price items
test_cases.expected_result: Sorting is stable or behaves in documented manner; UI does not crash and all items remain visible

test_cases.test_case: Verify accessibility basics for keyboard-only navigation
steps: 1. Use keyboard Tab/Shift+Tab to navigate through Login, Inventory, Cart, and Checkout controls
2. Use Enter/Space to activate focused buttons and links
test_cases.expected_result: Major interactive elements are reachable and operable via keyboard; focus order is logical and visible
